podcast.title: Writing Room Collaboration
podcast.body: Colin Cripps, described as a "great guitar player," shared a writing room in Toronto with Ian Thornley and Mark Fraccard, which was equipped with various gear. "I do remember having a little studio sort of writing room thing in town with Colin Crippson."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Ian Thornley - In His Own Words: Part 1

xref.title: Writing Room Collaboration
xref.body: Mark Fraccard, who was the front of house mixer for The Tragically Hip, shared a writing room in Toronto with Ian Thornley and Colin Cripps. "Mark Freakon. He was the front house mixer for the hip."
